subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you click + to add an [else] condition and drag the closed shell sprites into the opening?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How might you use an [else] condition to make something happen for the remaining percentage of time? 


Solution: 

The ninja should click + to add an [else] condition, then drag the four closed shell sprite blocks from the [if true then] opening into the [else] opening.


﻿
steps.instructions:
When the Player sprite overlaps the Goal sprite, the hermit crab retreats to its shell every time.


Fix the bugs in the code so the hermit crab pops out of its shell 60% of the time, else it retreats into its shell.

subgroups.title: Debugging If/Then/Else Conditionals

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Collect all the hermit crabs to see if they will retreat or pop out of their shell!

validationItems.failureText: Click + to add an [else] condition to the [if true then] block. Drag the hermit crab shell’s code blocks to the “else” opening.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Did you check to see what number is in the [% chance] value block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓What should you do to change the chance of the hermit crab retreating into its shell?


Solution:

The ninja should change the number in the [% chance] value block to something smaller than 100 (ideally around 40-60%).

﻿
steps.instructions:
When the Player sprite overlaps the Goal sprite, the hermit crab always pops out of its shell.


Fix the bugs in the code so there is a greater chance the hermit crab retreats into its shell and the Player can earn a point.

subgroups.title: Debugging If/Then/Else Conditionals

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Collect all the hermit crabs to see if they will retreat or pop out of their shell!

validationItems.failureText: Check the number in the [% chance] value block.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Did you try changing the operator in from the dropdown menu in the [0=0] value block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ Which operator sign signals that a value is greater than the other value?


❓Which operator sign signals that a value is less than the other value?


Solution:

The ninja should change the less than sign (<) to a greater than sign (>) in the [0=0] value block dropdown menu, within the [if true then] container block.

﻿
steps.instructions:
When the countdown ends, the WIN does not work as expected..


Fix the bugs in the code so that the game ends in a WIN only if the user’s score is greater than zero.

subgroups.title: Debugging If/Then/Else Conditionals
